name: SPI NOR Flash (W25/JEDEC)
description: Decodes SPI NOR flash commands compatible with the JEDEC/W25 instruction set: Winbond W25Q/W25R, GigaDevice GD25, ISSI IS25, Macronix MX25, Micron MT25Q, Spansion/Infineon S25FL and others. Covers Standard/Dual/Quad SPI, 3- and 4-byte addressing, and RPMC.
